summary: Glass Messenger Phase 4 (Saved Messages + Username-first search) fully verified. Backend 10/10 new tests pass + 72/72 full regression (Phase 1+2+3+4). Frontend: saved-pinned chat list, header title/subtitle, message persistence, @ hint chip (EN+FA), settings @username + copy-to-clipboard, RTL Persian localization, and DM header '· @username' suffix all confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/conversations/saved is idempotent and stores kind='saved' with single participant — correct contract.
GET /api/conversations partitions saved+dm and concatenates with saved first; dm sorted by last_message_at desc — pinned ordering enforced server-side (not relying on client).

GET /api/users/search correctly switches behaviour on leading '@' — username prefix matched via re.escape (safe from regex injection); falls back to username-prefix OR display_name-substring for unprefixed queries. Self excluded via _id $ne.
GET /api/users/by-username normalises to lower() before lookup (matches stored username casing). Returns 404 on miss.
SavedAvatar export from ChatList.jsx is now correctly imported by ChatPanel.jsx (earlier compile error in logs has been resolved — current build is green).

data-testid coverage for Phase 4 is complete: chat-list-item-saved, chat-list-saved-pinned-badge, chat-header-name, chat-header-presence, sidebar-search-input, search-username-hint, settings-username, copy-username-button, lang-fa-button, lang-en-button.

i18n strings (savedMessages, savedSubtitle, searchingUsernames, usernameCopied) present in both en and fa; FA strings verified at runtime ('پیام‌های ذخیره‌شده', 'فضای ابری شخصی شما', 'جستجوی یوزرنیم') and RTL dir='rtl' applied.
Clipboard write verified: navigator.clipboard.readText() returned '@alice' after clicking copy-username-button.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Phase 4 spec items verified including FA localization)
